textRuns.value: MISSION VALUE DECISION = FINANCIAL SUSTAINABILITY + MISSION IMPACT + LIQUIDITY + SCALABILITY − RISK — a management/board decision framework, NOT GAAP and NOT a CFA formula. The composite score never replaces the raw metrics: every alternative shows its cash flows, NPV, mission leverage, liquidity and risk side by side, and management can override the mechanical score with documented rationale.
The capital being allocated defaults to $250,000 and is globally editable in data/nfp/nfp_settings.csv (available_capital) — rerun python src/build_nfp.py and every number on tabs 9-12 recalculates.
